A small dark spot or blemish is now visible on the right side of the apple. The white background remains consistent, and the apple maintains its central position in the vertical frame. The lighting remains even and soft, typical of studio product photography.

The apple has rotated further, now revealing a different side with more yellow-orange coloring mixed with the red, particularly visible on the lower right portion. The stem appears slightly angled. A small dark mark is visible on the upper left area. The apple shows natural color variation typical of real fruit. The clean white background and centered composition remain consistent, with soft even lighting maintaining the professional product shot appearance throughout.
